findings.claim: Sequential gzip decoding delays filesystem extraction on the Next critical path.
findings.evidence: Frozen Next 16.3.6 extraction median: baseline 791.261 ms, pipelined 636.1305 ms (six balanced samples each). T3 cold 1978 to 1872.5 ms; CI-cold 1642.5 to 1580.5 ms. Full payload parity passed. Live peak RSS rises; report preserves this tradeoff.
findings.coverage: Frozen extraction; four-fixture installs; pipeline tests

findings.claim: Per-file copy buffers and fragmented reads cause avoidable writes/hash updates.
findings.evidence: One 64 KiB buffer replaces per-file initialization; read_exact coalesces fragmented reads. Frozen Next baseline 791.261 ms versus final serial 763.792 ms. No isolated end-to-end claim.
findings.coverage: Short-read/duplicate-digest tests; frozen archive parity; four-fixture installs

findings.claim: A repeated read after cancelled-stream EOF can panic the decode worker.
findings.evidence: The pre-fix EOF regression failed with Unfold must not be polled after Ready(None). Fused stream passes repeated EOF and stalled HTTP cancellation regressions, plus all 26 fetch tests.

findings.claim: Refactoring stream setup moved integrity parsing before staging creation, changing invalid-identity cleanup behavior.
findings.evidence: Existing known_sha512_stream_rejects_invalid_or_non_sha512_canonical_identities failed because objects_root was absent. Restored staging-before-hashing order passes that test and all 348 store tests.

research_reconciliation.scope: Bounded decode-ahead extraction. Prior diagnostics resolved attribution; unmeasured alternative mechanisms are research hypotheses, not verified defects.

original_async_research.NS1: Resolved through separate input-read timers; old stream_body_wall semantics preserved. Input intervals include scheduler/bridge waiting.
original_async_research.NS2: Worker queue/resume delays measured below1ms for Next in scored samples; no evidence they are the main bottleneck.
original_async_research.NS3: Decoder and hash boundaries instrumented; nested counters are not summed as independent wall costs. Both drains preserved.
original_async_research.NS4: Decode-ahead implemented as PIPE-01; reused/coalesced scratch as PIPE-02. Compressed buffering is not added on top without proving additive value.
original_async_research.NS5: Spool scheduling remains an unproven cause. No standalone diagnosis from elapsed HTTP timings; no code change justified by these observations.
